In Table 2 (p. 9), the highest reported titer is for **(−)-α-bisabolol** produced by the engineered strain **HBQA7 → SMB19**, reaching **102,300 mg L⁻¹ (102.3 g L⁻¹)**.

Conditions/strategy listed in the table (p. 9):
- **Cultivation mode:** fed-batch
- **Time:** 110 h
- **Strategy:** genome integration of the biosynthetic pathway and optimization of precursor supply (ref. [22])

The main text adds that this was achieved using a Haloarchaea-type MVA pathway background, with full chromosomal integration of the pathway enabling an antibiotic-free strain, and the record 102.3 g L⁻¹ was obtained in a 50-L bioreactor (p. 11).

For comparison, the next-highest titers in Table 2 are (2R,3R)-2,3-butanediol at 89,810 mg L⁻¹ (MG1 → ΔslaC-bdhA, fed-batch, 48 h) and acetoin at 75,200 mg L⁻¹ (H32 → H32-nox, fed-batch, 40 h) (p. 9).
